I have conducted a deep evidence-first assessment of the `orders-core` package and documented the complete findings in [ASSESSMENT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md) without modifying any existing application code.

### Verification Summary
- **Execution**: Ran `npm test` (`node --test test/pricing.test.js`) and verified that 2 tests passed successfully. Recorded exact command output in [ASSESSMENT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md).
- **Code Inspection**: Inspected [package.json](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/package.json), [README.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/README.md), [src/customers.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/src/customers.js), [src/pricing.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/src/pricing.js), [src/util.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/src/util.js), and [test/pricing.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-XSGpQe/workspace/test/pricing.test.js).
- **Key Findings Identified**:
  1. Circular dependency between `util.js` and `pricing.js` / `customers.js`.
  2. Documentation in `README.md` claiming everything in `util.js` is used, whereas functions like `formatMoney`, `describeOrder`, `chunk`, and `retry` are unreferenced internally.
  3. Missing test coverage for `customers.js` and `util.js`.
